issues.description: The problem statement explicitly requires the Animal.name attribute to use StringBuilder for efficient modifications, but the reference solution declares name as a String. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected attribute type and how getters/setters should be implemented.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the solution's Animal class use a StringBuilder for the name attribute to match the problem statement. For compatibility with existing constructors and usages, you can keep the constructor parameter as String but initialize the field as this.name = new StringBuilder(name); implement getName() to return name.toString() (or provide an additional getNameBuilder() if tests expect direct access), and implement setName(String newName) to update the StringBuilder (e.g., name.setLength(0); name.append(newName);). Update any related code accordingly.
